scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -b --force && node tooling/checks/copy-css.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p examples/vite-spa/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p examples/vite-ssr/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p examples/admin-template/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:perf
scripts.test:ssr: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @salmonui/example-vite-ssr && npm run build --workspace @salmonui/example-next-app && npm run test:ssr:run
scripts.test:ssr:run: npm run server:boundary:check && node --test --test-skip-pattern=@perf packages/data-grid/tests/ssr.test.ts "tests/ssr/*.test.ts" && playwright test --config playwright.ssr.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run examples:build && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @salmonui/example-vite-spa && npm run test:a11y:run
scripts.test:a11y:run: node --test packages/core/tests/theme.test.ts && playwright test a11y.spec keyboard.spec aria-snapshots.spec
scripts.test:examples: npm run build && npm run test:examples:run
scripts.examples:build: npm run build --workspace @salmonui/example-vite-spa && npm run build --workspace @salmonui/example-vite-ssr && npm run build --workspace @salmonui/example-next-app
scripts.bench: npm run build && npm run bench:run --
scripts.test:site: npm run build && npm run site:api && npm run docs:typecheck && npm run docs:coverage && playwright test -c docs/site/playwright.config.ts
scripts.site:verify: npm run build && npm run docs:typecheck && npm run docs:coverage && npm run docs:build && npm run site:build && SITE_MODE=export playwright test -c docs/site/playwright.config.ts && npm run site:check
